如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    许强进来之后，紧跟着他身后，四个大汉都也跟着走进来。
这四个人悍勇气息十足，看到里面有人要打架，非但不怕，反而一个个跃跃欲试，目光中流露出血腥味，一看就是见过血的。
“刀疤，怎么了？又在这里收保护费啊？这人欠你多少啊。赶紧把活干完，林姐有个事情找你帮忙。”许强开门见山道。
这个刀疤脸是城西一带的地头蛇，早上那个神秘的年轻人随便离开了，这湘潭市那么大，他许强又不是土地公，到哪里去找人？所以，只能找这些地头蛇帮忙了。
“啥？强哥，林姐有事找我帮忙？嘿，说啥帮忙啊。林姐，有事直接吩咐就行啊！”
说完，刀疤兴奋无比。
然后对着手下的小弟一挥手道：“听到没！还愣着做什么，先把这小子扔出去，然后咱们再去办林姐干活！”
“是！”众位小弟也都精神奕奕。跟着林姐混，那地位顿时是水涨船高！
“咦！”不过，那许强眼睛一瞥，忽然间感觉一旁刀疤要对付的小子有点眼熟。
“你不是那个……那个，神医啊！”
话一出口，许强三步并作两步的跑过来，哈哈大笑道：“神医啊。我可找到你了！没想到，能在这里跟你见面啊。”
看着刀疤脸手下那群人莫名其妙的脸色，许强先是走过去，每个人都揍了一个暴栗，在对方的痛哭之下，嚷道：“瞎了你们的狗眼。怎么得罪到我这位神医朋友了？”
“神医朋友？”
刀疤脸更加奇怪了。他跟许强很熟悉，从来没听过许强还认识神医。
而且，眼前这个土鳖，怎么看也不像神医吧。
许强一看刀疤脸的神色，就知道他在想什么，砰的一下拍在桌子上，问道：“怎么，刀疤，你有意见？”
“没意见没意见。”刀疤脸连连摇头道。他可不敢得罪许强。
杨云帆冷眼旁观，随后淡淡道：“你来找我，是不是早上那个小姐的意思？”
“是啊。不瞒神医，林姐对您能出手相救，十分感谢，特意让我找到神医，好当面感谢。我本想找这小子帮忙打听一下。没想到，这么巧，在这里就遇到了神医你啊。”许强搓着手，满脸喜悦。
“倒是挺巧的。”杨云帆淡然道。

这个神医，怎么态度这么冷淡啊？
许强心里有些犯嘀咕。
他转头一看，顿时明白了什么。
“神医，你稍等一会儿。”
他跟杨云帆打了个招呼，随后对刀疤恶狠狠道：“刀疤，你跟我出来一下。”
许强出去之后，很快就知道了，杨云帆到了店里之后跟刀疤发生了冲突。
他狠狠踹了刀疤脸一脚，骂道：“你这个死刀疤，平时就你最会惹事！这次，要是得罪了他，你就死定了！”
刀疤脸一脸不以为然道：“强哥你别吓我，我胆子小。这个土鳖有这么大来头？”
“哼！你看他是土鳖，因为你自己也是个土鳖。我告诉你，就是你嘴里说的这个土鳖，早上救了林姐一条命。你说，以林姐那有恩必报的性格来讲，你要是得罪了他，会有什么后果？”许强冷冷道。
“别别别，强哥，我可不敢想什么后果。不然，我怕晚上睡不着。不过，你放心，我虽然想揍他，但是还没动手。还有挽回的余地。我看他肯为一个素不相识的人出手，心眼应该不是太狠。这次算我倒霉，我知道怎么做了。”
刀疤脸知道这次，自己多半是要做赔本买卖了。怪只怪自己运气不好。
“嗯。你知道分寸就好。”许强点点头。他可不管这个刀疤脸亏钱不亏钱，只要杨云帆能跟他去见林红袖，其他的，都不是什么大事。
等两人进去之后，杨云帆看到刀疤脸垂头丧气的，好像赌钱输了几百万一样。他心里有些奇怪。
不过，很快，他就知道原因了。
只见那刀疤脸先是让人放了那个女老板的女儿，然后又把那女老板手里的转让书给撕掉了，最后又依依不舍的把那张欠条交给女老板，道：“算你运气好，遇到贵人了。你那老公是个王八蛋，我劝你还是赶紧离婚吧。”
说完，刀疤脸回到杨云帆旁边，又笑道：“这位小哥，刚才兄弟们不知道你是强哥的朋友，得罪了你，真是不好意思。若是看得起兄弟们，今晚我摆酒，再找两个漂亮小妞，给你接风洗尘，欢迎你来湘潭市。你觉得如何？”
杨云帆笑了一下，却是摇头道：“喝酒就不用了。我倒是没什么。不过，我看你的脸色不大好，眼球也有点发黄。估计肝脏不大好吧。你是不是右上腹部一喝酒就隐隐作疼？”

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. After Xu Qiang came in, four big men followed him in.
These four people were full of courage and breath. When they saw someone inside trying to fight, instead of being afraid, they were all eager to try. The smell of blood was in their eyes, and they knew they had seen blood at first sight.
"Scar, what's wrong? Are you collecting protection money here again? How much does this man owe you? Finish the work quickly, Sister Lin has something to ask you for help." Xu Qiang said straight to the point.
This scarred face is a local snake in the west area of ​​​​the city. The mysterious young man left casually in the morning. Xiangtan City is so big, and Xu Qiang is not a landowner. Where can he find someone? Therefore, we can only ask these local snakes for help.
"What? Brother Qiang, Sister Lin, you want me to help you with something? Hey, why are you asking for help? Sister Lin, if you need anything, just give me your instructions!"
After saying that, Scar was extremely excited.
Then he waved his hand to his subordinate and said, "Did you hear that? Why are you still standing there? Throw this guy out first, and then we can go do Sister Lin's work!"
"Yes!" All the younger brothers were also in high spirits. If you follow Sister Lin, your status will suddenly rise!
"Eh!" However, when Xu Qiang glanced at him, he suddenly felt that the boy Scar was going to deal with looked familiar.
"You are not that... that miracle doctor!"
As soon as the words came out, Xu Qiang ran over in three steps and laughed loudly: "Miracle doctor. I have found you! I didn't expect to meet you here."
Seeing the incomprehensible expressions on the faces of Scarface's men, Xu Qiang walked over first and gave each of them a beating. Under the other's crying, he shouted: "I've blinded you. How did you offend my friend, a miracle doctor?"
"Friends who are miracle doctors?"
Scarface was even stranger. He was very familiar with Xu Qiang, and he had never heard that Xu Qiang knew the miracle doctor.
Moreover, the bumpkin in front of me doesn’t look like a miracle doctor.
Xu Qiang looked at Scar's face and knew what he was thinking. He slammed the table and asked, "What, Scar, do you have any objections?"
"No objection, no objection." Scarface shook his head repeatedly. He didn't dare to offend Xu Qiang.
Yang Yunfan looked on coldly, and then said calmly: "Is it what the young lady said in the morning that you came to me?"
"Yes. To be honest with the miracle doctor, Sister Lin is very grateful for your help. She specially asked me to find the miracle doctor so that I can thank you in person. I originally wanted to ask this guy for help. I didn't expect that by such a coincidence, I met you, the miracle doctor, here." Xu Qiang rubbed his hands with joy on his face.
"It's quite a coincidence." Yang Yunfan said calmly.
Why is this miracle doctor so cold?
Xu Qiang felt a little guilty in his heart.
He turned around and realized something immediately.
"Miracle doctor, please wait a moment."
He said hello to Yang Yunfan, and then said fiercely to Scar: "Scar, come out with me."
After Xu Qiang went out, he soon learned that Yang Yunfan had a conflict with Scar after arriving at the store.
He kicked Scar's face hard and cursed: "You damn Scar, you are usually the most trouble-making! If you offend him this time, you will be dead!"
Scarface looked disapproving and said: "Brother Qiang, don't scare me, I'm timid. Does this country bumpkin have such a big background?"
"Hmph! You think he is a country bumpkin, because you are a country bumpkin yourself. Let me tell you, this country bumpkin you are talking about saved Sister Lin's life this morning. You said, considering Sister Lin's character of repaying kindness, what will be the consequences if you offend him?" Xu Qiang said coldly.
"No, no, no, Brother Qiang, I don't dare to think about the consequences. Otherwise, I'm afraid I won't be able to sleep at night. But don't worry, although I want to beat him, I haven't done it yet. There is still room for recovery. I think he is willing to take action for a stranger, and he must not be too arrogant.ruthless. This time I was unlucky, I knew what to do. "
Scarface knew that this time, he was probably going to make a loss-making deal. I just blame my bad luck.
"Hmm. Just know what's appropriate. "Xu Qiang nodded. He didn't care whether Scarface lost money or not. As long as Yang Yunfan could go with him to see Lin Hongxiu, the rest was not a big deal.
After the two of them entered, Yang Yunfan saw Scarface looking downcast, as if he had lost millions in gambling. There was something strange in his heart.
However, he soon knew the reason.
I saw the scar-faced man first letting the female boss's daughter go, then tearing up the transfer letter in the female boss's hand, and finally reluctantly handed the IOU to the female boss, saying: "You are lucky to have met a noble person. Your husband is a bastard, I advise you to divorce him as soon as possible. "
After saying that, Scarface returned to Yang Yunfan and said with a smile: "This little brother, just now the brothers didn't know that you were Brother Qiang's friend, so I offended you. I'm really sorry. If you think highly of me, brothers, I will serve wine tonight and find two beautiful girls to help you clean up your troubles. Welcome to Xiangtan City. What do you think? "
Yang Yunfan smiled, but shook his head and said: "There's no need to drink. I have nothing. However, I see that your complexion is not very good, and your eyeballs are a little yellow. I guess the liver is not very good. Do you feel a dull pain in your upper right abdomen whenever you drink alcohol? "
